2608.20009.title: ExPhy: A Benchmark for Explicit Physical Property Learning in Multi-Object Trajectory Forecasting
2608.20009.paper_summary: Understanding object dynamics requires not only predicting future trajectories but also examining whether a model captures the physical properties that govern motion. However, existing benchmarks rarely expose object-level physical properties as explicit evaluation targets alongside trajectory forecasting. To address this gap, we introduce \emph{ExPhy}, a multi-object trajectory forecasting benchmark containing 24,000 simulated physical scenes with explicit object-level labels for mass, friction, and restitution. ExPhy provides observed and future trajectories together with an in-distribution (ID) split and two out-of-distribution (OOD) splits over physical parameters (OOD-Parameter) and initial states (OOD-Initial) for jointly evaluating trajectory forecasting and physical property estimation. We further instantiate \textsc{PhyODE}, a physics-guided model with an explicit property interface that estimates physical properties from observed trajectories and uses them for differentiable future rollout. On the long-horizon OOD-Initial setting, \textsc{PhyODE} reduces ADE and FDE by 33.1\% and 31.0\%, respectively, compared with the strongest baseline. Zero-shot evaluation on ComPhy further assesses cross-benchmark transfer. Property-level analyses reveal that accurate trajectory forecasting does not necessarily imply accurate recovery of the underlying physical properties. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Zest86/ExPhy.
2608.20009.paper_summary_zh: 理解物體動態不僅需要預測未來的軌跡，還需要檢查模型是否捕捉到支配運動的物理特性。<lb/>然而，現有的基準很少將物體級別的物理特性作為明確的評估目標，與軌跡預測並列。<lb/>為了解決這一差距，我們引入了\emph{ExPhy}，這是一個多物體軌跡預測基準，包含24,000個模擬物理場景，並對質量、摩擦和恢復力提供明確的物體級別標籤。<lb/>ExPhy提供了觀察到的和未來的軌跡，並在物理參數（OOD-Parameter）和初始狀態（OOD-Initial）上進行了內部分佈（ID）劃分和兩個外部分佈（OOD）劃分，以便共同評估軌跡預測和物理特性估計。<lb/>我們進一步實現了\textsc{PhyODE}，這是一個物理引導的模型，具有明確的屬性接口，能夠從觀察到的軌跡中估計物理特性，並使用這些特性進行可微分的未來展開。<lb/>在長期的OOD-Initial設置中，\textsc{PhyODE}分別將ADE和FDE減少了33.1\%和31.0\%，與最強基準相比。<lb/>在ComPhy上的零-shot評估進一步評估了跨基準轉移。<lb/>屬性級別的分析顯示，準確的軌跡預測不一定意味著能準確恢復基礎的物理特性。<lb/>代碼和數據可在https://github.com/Zest86/ExPhy獲得。
